name: music.render
title: Music render (Strudel)
summary: Render a Strudel song to audio with the Mucavex engine: seeded deterministic noise, named section markers, optional tempo override and an analysis report.
description: Evaluates Strudel live-coding JavaScript with the same semantics as the strudel.cc REPL and renders it offline to WAV/MP3/FLAC/OGG/Opus/M4A. Named markers (lines like `let DROP = 34;`) let a build move song sections without regenerating the code. Strudel noise is seeded, so identical input gives byte-identical audio. `max_polyphony` must stay high: the engine's old default of 128 steals voices and fades sample voices in long renders. The tool renders; it never applies loudness normalisation, ducking or limiting.

code.description: Strudel source as a string. Exactly one of `code` and `file` is required.

file.description: A workspace `.strudel` or `.js` file holding the song: a workspace path, job:<id>/<output> or pin:<name>. Exactly one of `code` and `file` is required.

markers.description: Rewrite named marker lines (`let NAME = value;`) before rendering, e.g. {"DROP": 30}. An unknown name is an invalid-input error that lists the markers found in the song.

seconds.description: Render this many seconds. Wins over `cycles`. Omit both for the engine default of 4 cycles.

cycles.description: Render this many Strudel cycles. Omit both `cycles` and `seconds` for the engine default of 4.

cps.description: Cycles per second. Wins over `bpm`. Omit both to let the song's setcps/setcpm decide.

bpm.description: Beats per minute; converted with cps = bpm / 60 / beats_per_cycle. Omit (with `cps`) to let the song decide.

beats_per_cycle.description: Beats in one cycle, used only when `bpm` is given. 4 means one cycle is a 4/4 bar.

tail_s.description: Extra seconds after the last cycle so reverb and release tails are not cut off.

format.description: Output container/codec. wav is 16-bit PCM, wav32 is 32-bit float; flac/ogg/opus/m4a need ffmpeg.

bitrate_k.description: Bitrate in kbps for lossy formats (mp3, opus, m4a). Omit for the encoder default.

max_polyphony.description: Maximum simultaneous voices. Keep this high: Strudel's default of 128 steals voices, which fades earlier sample voices in long renders. Raise it further for very dense songs.

seed.description: Seed for the Math.random replacement Strudel noise uses. The same seed gives byte-identical audio; change it for a different noise take.

analyze.description: Also measure the render (peak/RMS/crest/clipping/warnings) and write analysis.json.

offline.description: Only load samples from the sample cache, never the network. A missing sample then fails the render instead of downloading it.

name.description: Output file name for the rendered audio. Default music.<ext>. The extension always follows format (a given .wav/.mp3/... is replaced), e.g. name "score" with format mp3 writes score.mp3.

seconds.description: Rendered duration in seconds, including the tail.

render_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds spent rendering the audio.

markers_applied.description: Markers that were rewritten, in request order.

value.description: Value written into the marker line.

analysis.description: Render analysis, or null when analyze is false.

peakDb.description: Absolute sample peak in dBFS (-Infinity serialises as null by JSON).

clippedSamples.description: Samples at or above full scale.
